from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The description of the financial line item as written")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the unit (e.g., thousands, millions, dollars)")
    section: str | None = Field(description="The section of the statement where the item is found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
